en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with cobblestone street in the foreground, a line of neatly trimmed trees and shrubs in the center, and two‑ to three‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs surrounding the square. One prominent building on the left bears the sign "Weinstube F. Leonold" and has a small onion‑domed tower rising behind it, suggesting a nearby town hall or church. Other façades show German‑language business signs, including a guesthouse or inn toward the right side.
